Name: Extended Bus Stop
Author: Christoffyw
Description:
This mod extends the Bus Stop map by 6 tiles to fill in the black bars when fully zoomed out in 1920x1080. The mod also modifies the Town map to change the warp locations to the Bus Stop.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Extended Bus Stop
Manifest.Description: Removes those pesky side bars when walking through the bus stop, fully zoomed-out.
